sdk_panel.title: ServiceNow SDK panel
sdk_panel.description: Adds /sdk-panel in Claude Code: a pane for the ServiceNow SDK command line (now-sdk) with setup, instances, commands and explain. It can run SDK commands, also against your instances, after you confirm each one. Turn it off for a plugin that only reads documentation.
